d: The Head of Legal will oversee all legal matters for Gastronomica, ensuring compliance with local and regional laws, managing legal risks, and providing strategic legal counsel to the executive team. The role requires a proactive leader with exceptional analytical skills, the ability to manage multiple jurisdictions across the GCC, and strong expertise in the restaurant and hospitality sector.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Law (LLB) from a reputable university; Master’s degree (LLM) or equivalent is preferred.
Minimum of 10 years of legal experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role, ideally within the F&B or hospitality sector.
Strong knowledge of GCC laws and regulations, including commercial, labor, and intellectual property law.
Proven experience managing legal issues in multi-jurisdictional environments.
Exceptional contract drafting, negotiation, and management skills.
Experience managing litigation and working with external legal counsel.
r: Provide strategic legal advice to the executive team on corporate matters, commercial agreements, compliance, and risk management.
Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations in the jurisdictions where Gastronomica operates.
Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts, including vendor agreements, franchise agreements, leases, supply contracts, and partnership agreements.
Establish and oversee policies to ensure compliance with corporate governance standards.
Manage litigation and disputes, including working with external counsel and representing the company in negotiations and legal proceedings.
Build and lead a high-performing legal team, ensuring they are equipped to handle the company’s legal needs.
Protect and manage the company’s intellectual property, including trademarks, patents, and copyrights.
Provide legal support during mergers, acquisitions, and joint ventures.
Identify, assess, and mitigate legal risks across the business.
